headline: Farmer's daughter Anushka Yadav made history in athletics by setting a new Indian national record, becoming the country's youngest record holder in her event.
Neeraj Chopra was named Best Male Athlete at the Indian Athletics Awards 2025, recognizing his outstanding performances and contributions to Indian track and field.
AP News reports that India is shifting its focus from cricket dominance to broader Olympic ambitions, outlining a strategic plan to enhance performance across multiple sports on the global stage.
